name: Jamna Auto Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1965, Jamna Auto Industries Limited manufactures conventional leaf springs, parabolic leaf  springs,  air  suspensions  and  lift  axles, predominantly  for  Commercial Vehicles.[1]
keyPoints:
Leadership Position:[1]
Company has  62 - 65% market share in commercial vehicle (CV) and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) in domestic market.
